pages.title: Establish an Owner First
pages.text: Machines accept only reliable identity. Inside a personal Xianqiao, the $(thing)realm owner takes priority$(). Elsewhere, a claimed Spirit Drive in the fuel slot may supply its owner. With neither source, the machine can use local storage but cannot enable Xianqiao Output.

pages.title: Two Switches, Two Routes
pages.text: $(thing)Xianqiao Output$() sends results to the owner's storage. $(thing)Automatic Output$() actively pushes local contents through enabled faces. Neither switch changes the other. If no owner exists or Xianqiao rejects a result, that result waits safely inside the machine.

pages.title: Enabling Xianqiao Output
pages.text: Simulated machines first flush all existing products to the owner's Xianqiao. A Xianeng Crystal flushes and zeroes its local resource, then points its capability at the Xianqiao ledger. Disabling it detaches that ledger and restarts an empty local cache. A crystal's extra item slot never enters Xianqiao.

pages.title: Every-Tick Output
pages.text: An enabled machine offers all currently available contents every tick; there is no hidden transfer cap. A crystal prioritizes processing-slot charging, then face output, then Xianqiao. Interface capabilities and scheduled Pull/Push are separate: pipe access does not turn on active scheduling.

pages.title: Fuel Is Not Ownership
pages.text: Inserted True Yuan or Immortal Yuan is ordinary item fuel. A Spirit Drive is reusable payment authorization and is never burned; it charges Immortal Yuan first, then True Yuan. Disabling Xianqiao Output never disables a drive. Only an empty-slot crystal bound by its realm stops automatic Immortal Yuan refill with that switch.

pages.title: Detailed Chapters
pages.text: See $(l:immortalstorage:automation/crystal_behavior)Xianeng Electricity Crystal$(/l), $(l:immortalstorage:automation/simulated_machines)Simulated Production$(/l), and $(l:immortalstorage:automation/interface)Xianqiao Interface$(/l). Source Veins retain their own charging rules; ordinary external resources no longer convert Immortal Yuan.
